verdict.rationale: An AI app-building platform could plausibly ship official SDKs, so this axis applies. The evidence pack never documents an official Lovable SDK for any language. The nearest items are a Lovable MCP server, a Build-with-URL link feature and Supabase-based Cloud, which are different capabilities, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
